paragraphs: Rav Acha, son of Rav Nachman: Shabbat 114a. Hon, son of Rav Nachman: Yevamot 34b. Mar Huna, son of Rav Nachman: Bava Batra 15a. Mar Zutra, son of Rav Nachman: Berakhot 43b.
Rabbi Chiya son of Rav Nachman, Bava Batra 15a.
Rav Papa, son of Rav Nachman: Bava Metzia 103a. Rabbah bar Rav Nachman: Shabbat 119a. Ravin bar Rav Nachman: Bava Batra 94b.

notes.text: Rav Nachman in the heading supplies the expansion of the repeated patronym initials. Hon, Mar Huna, Mar Zutra and the other names remain separate list entries.

The heading groups patronymic notices and does not establish that all the fathers named Nachman were one person. The consulted Shabbat 114a calls Acha Rabbi, while the supplied list calls him Rav; the supplied title is preserved.
